text:
maya (People Ops): idea — run a 'Manager Thankathon' envelope assembly: managers hand-deliver a short printed note + small snack to directs the week after performance reviews. low-touch, personal. yay or nay?

nav (Manager Ops): love it. can we give a 2-line template so managers aren't overwhelmed? quick wins only.

omar (Logistics): logistics: we'll prepare manager kits (cards, envelopes, sticker labels, 1 snack pack). estimate 120 manager kits. need CSV of manager -> directs count and office for shipping.

tia (Design): I'll produce a 4x6 folded card with a short prompt and space for signature. can do a printable PDF + sticker sheet by EOD tomorrow.

forms-bot: reminder scheduled — submit manager CSV and pickup/shipping prefs by 2015558200.

maya (People Ops): budget: ~$6/kit (printing + snack + envelope + postage) => ~$720 total. propose $500 from culture + $220 from spot-award admin. approve?

nav (Manager Ops): approved. also suggest printing a small 'From: <Manager>' line so managers only add one handwritten sentence.

omar (Logistics): variable-data printing for that is +$0.15/card. cheaper option: pre-printed sticker labels with manager name for remote kits.

tia (Design): sticker mock uploaded: thankathon-sticker-v1.png. guidance: max 18 chars for printed name.

maya (People Ops): action list: 1) final art (tia) 2) collect CSV & sticker plan (nav) 3) PO for kits (omar) 4) pack-night signup + Slack announcement (maya). I'll update when PO is placed. thanks everyone :sparkling_heart:
